## Importing file from Trailmaker and do Datacleaning
```{r,include=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
#Read the input
library(openxlsx)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)
library("Seurat")
library("limma")
library("clustree")
library("viridis")
library("glue")
library("knitr") 
library("BiocParallel")
library("here")
library("writexl")
library("jsonlite")
library("tidyverse")
amnion_seurat_object <- readRDS("amnion_seurat_object.rds")
```


```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(amnion_seurat_object[["RNA"]], layer = "counts")
metadata <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data

# -------------------------
# 2) Build new Seurat object
# -------------------------
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  meta.data = metadata,
  assay = "RNA",
  project = "Amnion_Rebuild"
)

# -------------------------
# 3) Preprocessing
# -------------------------
# Normalize
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4)

# Find variable features
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000)

# Scale data
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = rownames(obj))

# -------------------------
# 4) PCA
# -------------------------
obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), verbose = FALSE)

# -------------------------
# 5) Neighbors and Clustering
# -------------------------
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.5)

# -------------------------
# 6) UMAP
# -------------------------
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20)

amnion_seurat_object <- obj

amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = VariableFeatures(amnion_seurat_object), verbose = FALSE)
rm(obj)
rm(counts)

amnion_all <- amnion_seurat_object
gc()

```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CONSOLIDATE MOTHER/FETUS ORIGINS FROM THE CLEANED "Cell Type"
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Use @meta.data to safely extract the column as a true atomic vector
amnion_seurat_object[["Broad_Cell_Type"]] <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data[["Cell Type"]] %>%
  # Remove the words "Mother" or "Fetus"
  str_remove_all("Mother|Fetus") %>%
  # Clean up any trailing spaces or hyphens left over
  str_trim() %>%
  str_replace_all("-$", "") %>%
  str_trim()

# Set the active identity to this new combined column
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "Broad_Cell_Type"

# Quick sanity check: Print the new consolidated groups to your console
print(unique(Idents(amnion_seurat_object)))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RUN DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Ensure you are operating on the RNA assay
DefaultAssay(amnion_seurat_object) <- "RNA"

# (Optional: Uncomment if using Seurat v5 and layers need joining)
# amnion_seurat_object <- JoinLayers(amnion_seurat_object)

# Find markers for the consolidated cell types
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(amnion_seurat_object, 
                              only.pos = TRUE, 
                              min.pct = 0.25, 
                              logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Extract the top 20 markers per consolidated cell type
top20 <- all_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SAVE TO EXCEL
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Create a new main folder for these broad markers
main_dir <- "Amnion_Broad_Markers"
if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) {
  dir.create(main_dir)
}

# Save the outputs
write_xlsx(all_markers, file.path(main_dir, "all_broad_cell_type_markers.xlsx"))
write_xlsx(top20, file.path(main_dir, "top_20_broad_markers_per_cell_type.xlsx"))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. GENERATE AND SAVE FEATURE PLOTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_dir <- file.path(main_dir, "Feature_Plots")
cell_types <- unique(top20$cluster)

for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  
  # Replace characters like spaces or hyphens with underscores for safe folder names
  clean_name <- gsub("[[:punct:][:space:]]+", "_", cell_type)
  
  # Create the subfolder for this specific cell type
  cell_folder <- file.path(plot_dir, clean_name)
  if (!dir.exists(cell_folder)) {
    dir.create(cell_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Get the top 20 genes for this cell type
  genes_to_plot <- top20 %>% 
    filter(cluster == cell_type) %>% 
    pull(gene)
  
  for (gene in genes_to_plot) {
    if (gene %in% rownames(amnion_seurat_object)) {
      
      # Generate FeaturePlot
      p <- FeaturePlot(amnion_seurat_object, features = gene, reduction = "umap") +
        labs(title = paste0(cell_type, ": ", gene)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
      
      # Save individual plot
      file_out <- file.path(cell_folder, paste0(gene, "_FeaturePlot.png"))
      ggsave(filename = file_out, plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 150)
    }
  }
}

cat("Done! The broad analysis is finished using the cleaned up 'Cell Type' data. Outputs are in:", main_dir, "\n")
```

# Figure 2: General Change and HSP70/90.

### DEG Bulk

```{r}
amnion_no_graphs <- amnion_seurat_object
amnion_no_graphs@graphs <- list()

all_seurat_object_filtered <- subset(amnion_no_graphs, subset = timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))
all_seurat_object_filtered <- subset(all_seurat_object_filtered, subset = tissue_source %in% c("Peripher"))

pseudo_bulk <- AggregateExpression(all_seurat_object_filtered, assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("timepoint_plus", "Donor_Nr", "cell_type"))

pseudo_bulk$celltype.stim <- paste(pseudo_bulk$timepoint_plus, pseudo_bulk$cell_type, sep = "_")
Idents(pseudo_bulk) <- "celltype.stim"
```

```{r}
# Create a list to store DE results
de_results <- list()

# Get unique cell types
cell_types <- unique(pseudo_bulk$cell_type)

# Iterate over each cell type
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  ident_1 <- paste("Week-25", cell_type, sep = "_")
  ident_2 <- paste("Week-38", cell_type, sep = "_")
  
  # Get the number of cells in each group
  cells_1 <- WhichCells(pseudo_bulk, idents = ident_1)
  cells_2 <- WhichCells(pseudo_bulk, idents = ident_2)
  
  # Check if both groups have at least 3 cells
  if (length(cells_1) >= 3 & length(cells_2) >= 3) {
    # Perform differential expression analysis
    de_result <- FindMarkers(object = pseudo_bulk, 
                             ident.1 = ident_2, 
                             ident.2 = ident_1,
                             test.use = "DESeq2",
                             logfc.threshold = 0.0)
    
    # Ensure gene names are preserved as row names
    de_result$Gene <- rownames(de_result)
    
    # Store results in a list
    de_results[[cell_type]] <- de_result
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping", cell_type, "because one or both groups have fewer than 3 cells."))
  }
}

# Write results to an Excel file if there are valid comparisons
if (length(de_results) > 0) {
  # Save each DE result as a separate sheet in the Excel file
  output_file <- "DE_results.xlsx"
  write.xlsx(de_results, file = output_file, rowNames = TRUE)  # rowNames=TRUE ensures gene names are included
  message("DE analysis results saved to DE_results.xlsx")
} else {
  message("No valid comparisons. No file was created.")
}

```

### Change in differential expression between cell types Bulk? 

Dotplot: X axis are the cell types, y axis are the log fold change (p-value are in colors (blue to red)), and siginficant ones are square and not are dots



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Combine results from all cell types into one data frame
de_df <- bind_rows(de_results, .id = "CellType")

# Filter for significant genes only (adjusted p-value < 0.05)
plot_df <- de_df %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

# Create Figure2 folder if it doesn't exist
if(!dir.exists("Figure2")){
  dir.create("Figure2")
}

# Dot plot with jitter for better scatter
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = CellType, y = avg_log2FC, 
                         color = p_val_adj)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Log2 Fold Change", color = "Adjusted p-value")

# Save the plot
ggsave("Figure2/scattered_dotplot_significant.png", plot = p, width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# Desired order (make sure names match your cleaned CellType values)
desired_order <- c(
  "Endometrial Mother", "Decidual Mother", "Fibroblast Mother", "LED Mother",
  "Macrophage Mother", "T-Cell-Resting Mother","HSC Mother", "EVT Fetus", "CTB Fetus", "Stromal Fetus","Epithelial Fetus"
)

desired_order <- rev(desired_order)

plot_df <- de_df %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05)

  mutate(CellType = CellType %>%
```

#### Ratio cell types (removed contanminated Donor 1003)

```{r}
amnion_no_graphs <- amnion_seurat_object
amnion_no_graphs@graphs <- list()
amnion_seurat_object_nocon <- subset(amnion_no_graphs, subset = !(Donor_Nr %in% c(1003, 1004)))

```

```{r}
amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = gsub("_", " ", layer_and_gestation)) %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = case_when(
    Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Amnion" ~ "Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia",
    Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Chorion" ~ "Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia",
    TRUE ~ layer_and_gestation2
  ))

metadata <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data
```

```{r}

library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

n_colors = 17
n_colors <- length(unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon$cell_type))
color_palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_colors)

# Step 1: Calculate actual cell counts

cell_counts <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(samples, layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Cell_Count = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")


# Step 2: Get all unique samples and cell types (only)
all_samples <- unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data$samples)
all_cell_types <- unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data$cell_type)

# Step 3: Expand data to include all sample–cell_type combinations
# Only existing combinations of (sample, layer_and_gestation2) are kept
cell_counts_complete <- cell_counts %>%
  group_by(samples, layer_and_gestation2) %>%
  complete(cell_type = all_cell_types, fill = list(Cell_Count = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 4: Calculate total and percentages per sample
sample_percentage_data <- cell_counts_complete %>%
  group_by(samples) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Cells = sum(Cell_Count),
    Sample_Percentage = ifelse(Total_Cells > 0, (Cell_Count / Total_Cells) * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(samples, layer_and_gestation2, cell_type, Sample_Percentage)

# Ensure correct ordering of 'layer_and_gestation22' factor in sample data
sample_percentage_data <- sample_percentage_data %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = factor(layer_and_gestation2, levels = c("Amnion Midterm","Amnion Preterm","Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia","Amnion Term", "Amnion Term Placenta","Chorion Midterm","Chorion Preterm","Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia","Chorion Term","Chorion Term Placenta")))

# Step 2: Calculate mean and standard error for each cell type within each layer_and_gestation2
error_data <- sample_percentage_data %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Percentage = mean(Sample_Percentage),
    SE_Percentage = sd(Sample_Percentage) #/ sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Calculate the number of cells per cell_type within each group
cell_type_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  tally(name = "cell_type_count") # Rename 'n' to 'cell_type_count' directly

# Calculate the total number of cells per group
total_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2) %>%
  tally(name = "total_cell_count")

# Merge counts and calculate percentages
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_counts %>%
  left_join(total_counts, by = "layer_and_gestation2") %>%
  mutate(percentage = (cell_type_count / total_cell_count) * 100)

# Define the order of the groups
group_order <- c("Amnion Midterm","Amnion Preterm","Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia","Amnion Term", "Amnion Term Placenta","Chorion Midterm","Chorion Preterm","Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia","Chorion Term","Chorion Term Placenta")

# Reorder the groups in the data frame
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = factor(layer_and_gestation2, levels = group_order))

# Add a new column with the total count for each cell type across all groups
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  mutate(total_cell_type_count = sum(cell_type_count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping

# Create a named vector for facet labels including total cell counts per cell type
facet_labels <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  distinct(cell_type, total_cell_type_count) %>%  # Keep unique cell_type and its total
  mutate(label = paste0(cell_type, "\n (Total: ", total_cell_type_count, ")")) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, label) %>%
  deframe()


# Step 3: Use your existing error_data and sample_percentage_data for plotting
cell_type_plot <- ggplot(error_data, aes(x = layer_and_gestation2, y = Mean_Percentage, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Percentage - SE_Percentage, ymax = Mean_Percentage + SE_Percentage),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9), color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_point(data = sample_percentage_data,
             aes(x = layer_and_gestation2, y = Sample_Percentage),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.2),
             size = 2, color = "darkgrey", alpha = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_type, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(cell_type = facet_labels)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Each Cell Type Across Groups",
       x = "layer_and_gestation2",
       y = "Percentage (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none")

# Print and save
print(cell_type_plot)

ggsave("Figure2/gestational_cell_type_barplot_with_error_bars_darkgrey_correct_totals.png",
       plot = cell_type_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

### Check for Significance in the Cell Proporotions

```{r}
library(speckle)
set.seed(123)

run_prop <- function(meta, keep, label) {
  m <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(layer_and_gestation2 %in% keep)
  res <- propeller(clusters  = m$cell_type,
                   sample    = m$samples,
                   group     = droplevels(factor(m$layer_and_gestation2)),
                   transform = "logit")
  res$cell_type  <- rownames(res)
  res$comparison <- label
  write.csv(res, file.path("Figure2", paste0("propeller_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  res
}

meta <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data

prop_omnibus       <- propeller(clusters = meta$cell_type, sample = meta$samples,
                                group = meta$layer_and_gestation2, transform = "logit")
prop_amnion_gest   <- run_prop(meta, c("Amnion Midterm",  "Amnion Term"),           "amnion_term_vs_mid")
prop_chorion_gest  <- run_prop(meta, c("Chorion Midterm", "Chorion Term"),          "chorion_term_vs_mid")
prop_amnion_place  <- run_prop(meta, c("Amnion Term",     "Amnion Term Placenta"),  "amnion_placenta_vs_periph")
prop_chorion_place <- run_prop(meta, c("Chorion Term",    "Chorion Term Placenta"), "chorion_placenta_vs_periph")

prop_amnion_gest[order(prop_amnion_gest$FDR), ]
prop_chorion_gest[order(prop_chorion_gest$FDR), ]
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

# Function to perform pseudobulk and t-test for a single module
test_module <- function(module_name, seurat_obj, timepoints = c("Week_25", "Week_38")) {
  
  # Extract metadata with module scores
  meta_scores <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% timepoints)
  
  # Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Determine score column
  score_col <- paste0("mean_", module_name, "1")
  
  # Test each cell type separately
  results_list <- list()
  cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
      filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
      t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
      add_significance("p")
    
    test_res$cell_type <- ct
    test_res$module <- module_name
    
    results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
  }
  
  # Combine results
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  return(results_df)
}

# Example usage for "HeatShock" module
heatshock_results <- test_module("HeatShock", amnion_seurat_object)
heatshock_results
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

test_module <- function(module_name, seurat_obj,
                        timepoints = c("Week_25", "Week_38")) {
  
  meta_scores <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% timepoints)
  
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      score = mean(.data[[paste0(module_name, "1")]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Summary stats for Cohen's d
  summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(score),
      sd = sd(score),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Compute Cohen's d per cell type
  effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pooled_sd = sqrt(
        ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
         (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
        (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
      ),
      cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)
  
  # T-tests with CI
  test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Combine everything
  results_df <- test_df %>%
    left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
    mutate(
      module = module_name,
      test = "two-sided Student's t-test"
    )
  
  return(results_df)
}


# Example usage for "HeatShock" module
heatshock_results <- test_module("HeatShock", amnion_seurat_object)
heatshock_results

results_df <- heatshock_results
sig_results <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05)

legend_text <- sig_results %>%
  mutate(
    t_round = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(sentence)


figure_legend_stats <- paste(legend_text, collapse = "; ")
cat(figure_legend_stats)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 1. Filter by prioritization_score > 0.75
filtered_df <- cell_cell_communication %>%
  filter(prioritization_score > 0.75)

# 2. Count sending and receiving interactions per group and cell type
sending_counts <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(group, cell_type = sender) %>%
  summarise(sending = n(), .groups = "drop")

receiving_counts <- filtered_df %>%
  group_by(group, cell_type = receiver) %>%
  summarise(receiving = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 3. Merge sending and receiving counts
cell_counts <- full_join(sending_counts, receiving_counts,
                         by = c("group", "cell_type")) %>%
  replace_na(list(sending = 0, receiving = 0))

# 4. Reshape for arrows Week_25 -> Week_38
arrow_data <- cell_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(sending, receiving)) %>%
  drop_na(sending_Week_25, sending_Week_38,
          receiving_Week_25, receiving_Week_38)

# 5. Plot with arrows + multinichenet colors
p <- ggplot() +
  # arrows
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_data,
    aes(x = sending_Week_25, y = receiving_Week_25,
        xend = sending_Week_38, yend = receiving_Week_38,
        color = cell_type),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_sender) +   # 🔥 multinichenet palette here
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Interactions (Week 25 → Week 38)",
    x = "Number of Sending Interactions",
    y = "Number of Receiving Interactions",
    color = "Cell Type",
    shape = "Group"
  )

# Save the plot
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------

pseudobulk_df <- meta_expr_long %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, gene, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each gene across timepoints
# -----------------------------
results_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  t_test(mean_expr ~ timepoint) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  ungroup()

results_df
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Define WNT-related modules
# ===============================

# Core canonical WNT/β-catenin pathway
Canonical_WNT <- c(
  "WNT1","WNT3","WNT3A","WNT7A","WNT7B","WNT8A","WNT8B",   # canonical ligands
  "LRP5","LRP6","FZD1","FZD2","FZD5","FZD7","FZD9","FZD10", # receptors & co-receptors
  "CTNNB1","APC","AXIN1","AXIN2","GSK3B","CSNK1A1", # destruction complex
  "TCF7","LEF1","TCF7L1","TCF7L2" # transcription factors
)

# Canonical-specific inhibitors
Canonical_WNT_Inhibitors <- c(
  "DKK1","DKK2","DKK3","DKK4", # Dickkopf family
  "KREMEN1","KREMEN2",         # co-receptors for DKK
  "NOTUM"                      # WNT ligand deacylase
)

# Broad inhibitors (ligand sequestration, canonical + non-canonical)
Broad_WNT_Inhibitors <- c(
  "SFRP1","SFRP2","SFRP3","SFRP4","SFRP5", # secreted frizzled-related proteins
  "WIF1"                                  # WNT inhibitory factor
)

# Non-canonical WNT/PCP (Planar Cell Polarity) pathway
NonCanonical_PCP <- c(
  "WNT5A","WNT5B","WNT11",   # non-canonical ligands
  "FZD3","FZD6",             # receptors
  "ROR1","ROR2","PTK7",      # co-receptors
  "DVL1","DVL2","DVL3",      # Dishevelled proteins
  "DAAM1","PRICKLE1","PRICKLE2","CELSR1","CELSR2","CELSR3", # polarity genes
  "RHOA","RAC1","CDC42","JNK1","MAPK8" # downstream effectors
)

# Non-canonical WNT/Ca2+ pathway
NonCanonical_Ca2 <- c(
  "WNT5A","WNT11",          # ligands
  "FZD2","FZD5","FZD7",     # receptors
  "DVL1","DVL2","DVL3",     # Dishevelled
  "PLC","PLCB1","PLCB2","PLCB3", # phospholipase C family
  "PRKCA","PRKCB","PRKCG",  # PKC family
  "CAMK2A","CAMK2B","CAMK2D","CAMK2G", # CaMKII
  "NFATC1","NFATC2","NFATC3","NFATC4" # NFAT transcription factors
)

# Downstream transcriptional regulators (β-catenin dependent)
WNT_Transcriptional_Regulators <- c(
  "MYC","CCND1","AXIN2","LEF1","TCF7L2","JUN","FOSL1"
)

# WNT-associated ubiquitin/proteasome regulation
WNT_Ubiquitin_Regulation <- c(
  "FBXW7","BTRC","RNF43","ZNRF3","USP14","USP34"
)

# ===============================
# Collect into list
# ===============================
modules <- list(
  Canonical_WNT = Canonical_WNT,
  Canonical_WNT_Inhibitors = Canonical_WNT_Inhibitors,
  Broad_WNT_Inhibitors = Broad_WNT_Inhibitors,
  NonCanonical_PCP = NonCanonical_PCP,
  NonCanonical_Ca2 = NonCanonical_Ca2,
  WNT_Transcriptional_Regulators = WNT_Transcriptional_Regulators,
  WNT_Ubiquitin_Regulation = WNT_Ubiquitin_Regulation
)

# ===============================
# Add module scores
# ===============================
for (module_name in names(modules)) {
  amnion_seurat_object_filtered <- AddModuleScore(
    object = amnion_seurat_object_filtered,
    features = list(modules[[module_name]]),
    name = module_name
  )
}

# ===============================
# Extract module scores + metadata
# ===============================
meta_df <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(names(modules))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(names(modules)),
    names_to = "module",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    module = gsub("\\d+$", "", module)  # remove numeric suffix from AddModuleScore
  )

# ===============================
# Plotting
# ===============================
library(ggplot2)
module_plots <- list()

for (module_name in names(modules)) {
  score_col <- paste0(module_name, "1")
  
  p <- ggplot(amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data, 
              aes_string(x = "cell_type", y = score_col, fill = "timepoint")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      y = "Module Score",
      x = "Cell Type",
      fill = "Timepoint",
      title = module_name
    )
  
  module_plots[[module_name]] <- p
}

# ===============================
# Print all module plots
# ===============================
for (module_name in names(module_plots)) {
  print(module_plots[[module_name]])
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "Canonical_WNT1"  # <-- change this to the module you want

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------

meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Determine score column
# -----------------------------
score_col <- paste0("mean_", module_name)

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$module <- module_name
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df
```

```{r}
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    score = mean(.data[[module_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Summary statistics for effect size
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(score),
    sd = sd(score),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Compute Cohen’s d (unpaired)
# -----------------------------
effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------
test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------
results_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    module = module_name,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(sentence)

figure_legend_stats <- paste(legend_text, collapse = "; ")
cat(figure_legend_stats)


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "Canonical_WNT_Inhibitors1"  # <-- change this to the module you want

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------

meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Determine score column
# -----------------------------
score_col <- paste0("mean_", module_name)

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$module <- module_name
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df
```

```{r}
# Define VEGFA-related modules

# Ligand
VEGFA_Ligand <- c("VEGFA") 

# Receptors
VEGFA_Receptors <- c("FLT1", "KDR", "FLT4") 

# Downstream signaling components (canonical VEGF pathways)
VEGFA_Downstream <- c(
  "AKT1", "PIK3CA", "PIK3CB", "MAPK1", "MAPK3", "PLCG1", "SRC", "NOS3"
)

# Inhibitors / regulators
VEGFA_Inhibitors <- c(
  "FLT1", "THBS1", "VEGFR1_sFlt1"  # FLT1 can act as decoy too
)

# Collect into list
vegf_modules <- list(
  Ligand = VEGFA_Ligand,
  Receptors = VEGFA_Receptors,
  Downstream = VEGFA_Downstream,
  Inhibitors = VEGFA_Inhibitors
)

# Add module scores
for (module_name in names(vegf_modules)) {
  amnion_seurat_object_filtered <- AddModuleScore(
    object = amnion_seurat_object_filtered,
    features = list(vegf_modules[[module_name]]),
    name = module_name
  )
}

# Extract module scores and metadata
meta_df <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(names(vegf_modules))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(names(vegf_modules)),
    names_to = "module",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    module = gsub("\\d+$", "", module)  # remove numeric suffix from AddModuleScore
  )

library(ggplot2)

# Plotting
vegf_module_plots <- list()

for (module_name in names(vegf_modules)) {
  score_col <- paste0(module_name, "1")
  
  p <- ggplot(amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data, 
              aes_string(x = "cell_type", y = score_col, fill = "timepoint")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      y = "Module Score",
      x = "Cell Type",
      fill = "Timepoint",
      title = module_name
    )
  
  vegf_module_plots[[module_name]] <- p
}

# Example to view
print(vegf_module_plots$Ligand)
print(vegf_module_plots$Receptors)
print(vegf_module_plots$Downstream)
print(vegf_module_plots$Inhibitors)

# Optionally save
# ggsave("Figure3/VEGFA_Ligand_module_byCellType.png", plot = vegf_module_plots$Ligand, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  )

p
```

```{r}
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------

  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(mean_expr ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------

  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    gene = gene,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
```

````{r}
# Define TGFB-related modules

# Ligands
TGFB_Ligands <- c("TGFB1", "TGFB2", "TGFB3")

# Receptors
TGFB_Receptors <- c("TGFBR1", "TGFBR2", "TGFBR3")

# Downstream signaling components
TGFB_Downstream <- c(
  "SMAD2", "SMAD3", "SMAD4",    # canonical SMAD pathway
  "MAPK14", "JUN", "JNK1", "PIK3CA", "PIK3CB"  # non-canonical pathways
)

# Inhibitors / regulators
TGFB_Inhibitors <- c("SMAD7", "BAMBI", "LEFTY1", "LEFTY2", "FST")

# Collect into list
tgfb_modules <- list(
  TGFB_Ligands = TGFB_Ligands,
  TGFB_Receptors = TGFB_Receptors,
  TGFB_Downstream = TGFB_Downstream,
  TGFB_Inhibitors = TGFB_Inhibitors
)

# Add module scores
for (module_name in names(tgfb_modules)) {
  amnion_seurat_object_filtered <- AddModuleScore(
    object = amnion_seurat_object_filtered,
    features = list(tgfb_modules[[module_name]]),
    name = module_name
  )
}

# Extract module scores and metadata
meta_df <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(names(tgfb_modules))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(names(tgfb_modules)),
    names_to = "module",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    module = gsub("\\d+$", "", module)  # remove numeric suffix from AddModuleScore
  )

library(ggplot2)

# Plotting
tgfb_module_plots <- list()

for (module_name in names(tgfb_modules)) {
  score_col <- paste0(module_name, "1")
  
  p <- ggplot(amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data, 
              aes_string(x = "cell_type", y = score_col, fill = "timepoint")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(
      y = "Module Score",
      x = "Cell Type",
      fill = "Timepoint",
      title = module_name
    )
  
  tgfb_module_plots[[module_name]] <- p
}

# Example to view
print(tgfb_module_plots$TGFB_Ligands)
print(tgfb_module_plots$TGFB_Receptors)
print(tgfb_module_plots$TGFB_Downstream)
print(tgfb_module_plots$TGFB_Inhibitors)

# Optionally save
# ggsave("Figure3/TGFB_Ligands_module_byCellType.png", plot = tgfb_module_plots$Ligands, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "TGFB_Ligands1"  # <-- change this to the module you want

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------

meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Determine score column
# -----------------------------
score_col <- paste0("mean_", module_name)

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$module <- module_name
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df


```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <-"TGFB_Ligands1"

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    score = mean(.data[[module_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Summary statistics for effect size
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(score),
    sd = sd(score),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Compute Cohen’s d (unpaired)
# -----------------------------
effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------
test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------
results_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    module = module_name,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(sentence)

figure_legend_stats <- paste(legend_text, collapse = "; ")
cat(figure_legend_stats)


```



```{r}

cell_types <- unique(plot_data$cell_type)

results <- lapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
  temp <- plot_data %>% filter(cell_type == ct, timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))
  test <- wilcox.test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint")), data = temp)
  data.frame(cell_type = ct,
             p_value = test$p.value)
})

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)
results_df

  "AKT1","AKT2","AKT3",

)

)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "IGF_Regulators1"

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    score = mean(.data[[module_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Summary statistics for effect size
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(score),
    sd = sd(score),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Compute Cohen’s d (unpaired)
# -----------------------------
effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------
test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------
results_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    module = module_name,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(sentence)

figure_legend_stats <- paste(legend_text, collapse = "; ")
cat(figure_legend_stats)


```

### Basment Membrane Remodeling

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(openxlsx)  # use openxlsx for write_xlsx

# Function to get gene symbols from a GO term
get_genes_from_go <- function(go_term) {
  entrez_ids <- as.character(
    unique(AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = go_term,
      columns = "ENTREZID",
      keytype = "GOALL"
    )$ENTREZID)
  )
  gene_symbols <- bitr(entrez_ids, fromType="ENTREZID", toType="SYMBOL", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)$SYMBOL
  return(gene_symbols)
}

plot_deg_go <- function(seurat_obj, go_genes, label, time1, time2, out_prefix) {
  
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$timepoint
  
  degs <- FindMarkers(
    seurat_obj,
    ident.1 = time1,
    ident.2 = time2,
    min.pct = 0.01,
    logfc.threshold = 0
  )
  
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)
  
  degs_go <- degs %>% filter(gene %in% go_genes)

  
  # Update Significance: only consider genes with abs(log2FC) > 1 AND p_val_adj < 0.05
  degs_go <- degs_go %>%
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1  ~ "Upregulated",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ))
  
  # Volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(degs_go, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = degs_go %>%
        filter(Significance != "Not Significant"),  # only label red/blue genes
      aes(label = gene),
      max.overlaps = 20,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      segment.color = 'grey50'
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title =  gsub("_", " ",paste(label, "DEGs:", time1, "vs", time2)),
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value"
    )
  
  ggsave(paste0("Figure4/Vukcano_Plot_", out_prefix, ".png"),
         plot = p, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  print(p)
  
  return(degs_go)
}


# --- Basement Membrane ---
basement_go <- "GO:0005604"  # "basement membrane"
basement_genes <- get_genes_from_go(basement_go)
degs_go <- plot_deg_go(all_seurat_object_filtered, basement_genes, "Basement Membrane", "Week_38", "Week_25", "Basement_Membrane")

# Filter for significant genes
sig_genes <- degs_go[degs_go$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]

# Count upregulated and downregulated
upregulated <- sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC > 0)
downregulated <- sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC < 0)

# Print results
cat("Upregulated genes:", upregulated, "\n")
cat("Downregulated genes:", downregulated, "\n")

````

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)  # for writing Excel files

# Make sure your Seurat object has these metadata columns:
# "cell_type" and "timepoint" (Week_38, Week_25)

# Get unique cell types
cell_types <- unique(amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data$cell_type)

# Create a new workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Loop over cell types and do DE
for (ct in cell_types) {
  
  # Subset Seurat object to this cell type
  cells_ct <- subset(amnion_seurat_object_filtered, subset = cell_type == ct)
  
  # Run differential expression between Week_38 and Week_25
  de_res <- FindMarkers(
    cells_ct, 
    ident.1 = "Week_38", 
    ident.2 = "Week_25",
    group.by = "timepoint",
    logfc.threshold = 0,   # include all genes
    min.pct = 0            # include all genes
  )
  
  # Add gene names as a column
  de_res <- de_res %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "gene")
  
  # Add a new sheet to the workbook
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = ct)
  writeData(wb, sheet = ct, de_res)
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, file = "DE_per_celltype_Week38_vs_Week25.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Genes of interest
# -----------------------------
genes <- c("COL3A1","COL4A3","COL4A4","COL5A2","COL12A1","COL16A1")

# -----------------------------
# Initialize results storage
# -----------------------------
all_results <- list()
all_legends <- list()

# -----------------------------
# Loop over genes
# -----------------------------
for (gene in genes) {

  # Extract normalized expression
  expr_vec <- FetchData(amnion_seurat_object_filtered, vars = gene)

  # Add gene expression to metadata
  amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data[[paste0(gene, "_expr")]] <- expr_vec[,1]

  # Extract metadata and filter timepoints
  meta_expr <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, expr = paste0(gene, "_expr")) %>%
    filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

  # Pseudobulk: average gene expression per donor per cell type
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_expr %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Summary statistics for Cohen's d
  summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      n    = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = timepoint,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pooled_sd = sqrt(
        ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
         (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
        (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
      ),
      cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

  # Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
  test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    t_test(mean_expr ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Combine statistics
  results_df <- test_df %>%
    left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
    mutate(
      gene = gene,
      test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
    )

  all_results[[gene]] <- results_df

  # Create journal-style legend for significant results
  legend_text <- results_df %>%
    filter(p < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(
      t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
      df_round = round(df, 2),
      d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
      p_text = ifelse(
        p < 0.001,
        "P < 0.001",
        paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
      ),
      sentence = paste0(
        gene, " - ", cell_type,
        ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
        ", ", p_text,
        ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(sentence)

  all_legends[[gene]] <- legend_text
}

# -----------------------------
# Combine all results and legends
# -----------------------------
final_results <- bind_rows(all_results)
figure_legend_stats <- paste(unlist(all_legends), collapse = "; ")

cat(figure_legend_stats)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(Seurat)

# -----------------------------
# Specify gene to test
# -----------------------------
gene <- "COL1A1"   # <-- change this to any gene

# -----------------------------
# Extract normalized expression
# -----------------------------
expr_vec <- FetchData(amnion_seurat_object_filtered, vars = gene)

# Add gene expression to metadata
amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data[[paste0(gene, "_expr")]] <- expr_vec[,1]

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_expr <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, expr = paste0(gene, "_expr")) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average gene expression per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_expr %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(mean_expr ~ timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$gene <- gene
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df



```

```{r}
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

# Determine score column

# Perform t-test for each cell type

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$module <- module_name
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "EMT_drivers1"

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    score = mean(.data[[module_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Summary statistics for Cohen’s d
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Compute Cohen’s d (unpaired)
# -----------------------------
effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------
test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------
results_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    module = module_name,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "MET_drivers1"

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    score = mean(.data[[module_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Summary statistics for Cohen’s d
# -----------------------------
summary_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# -----------------------------
# Compute Cohen’s d (unpaired)
# -----------------------------
effectsize_df <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(mean, sd, n)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_sd = sqrt(
      ((n_Week_25 - 1) * sd_Week_25^2 +
       (n_Week_38 - 1) * sd_Week_38^2) /
      (n_Week_25 + n_Week_38 - 2)
    ),
    cohens_d = (mean_Week_38 - mean_Week_25) / pooled_sd
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, cohens_d)

# -----------------------------
# Perform Welch t-tests per cell type
# -----------------------------
test_df <- pseudobulk_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  t_test(score ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

# -----------------------------
# Combine statistics
# -----------------------------
results_df <- test_df %>%
  left_join(effectsize_df, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    module = module_name,
    test = "two-sided Welch’s t-test"
  )

results_df

legend_text <- results_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(
    t_round  = round(statistic, 2),
    df_round = round(df, 2),
    d_round  = round(cohens_d, 2),
    p_text = ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "P < 0.001",
      paste0("P = ", signif(p, 3))
    ),
    sentence = paste0(
      cell_type,
      ": t(", df_round, ") = ", t_round,
      ", ", p_text,
      ", Cohen’s d = ", d_round
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(sentence)

figure_legend_stats <- paste(legend_text, collapse = "; ")
cat(figure_legend_stats)


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------
# Specify module to test
# -----------------------------
module_name <- "MET_effectors1"  # <-- change this to the module you want

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------

meta_scores <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, starts_with(module_name)) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average module score per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(starts_with(module_name), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Determine score column
# -----------------------------
score_col <- paste0("mean_", module_name)

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste(score_col, "~ timepoint"))) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$module <- module_name
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Specify gene to test
# -----------------------------
gene <- "COL12A1"   # <-- change this to any gene

# -----------------------------
# Extract normalized expression
# -----------------------------

# Add gene expression to metadata
amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data[[paste0(gene, "_expr")]] <- expr_vec[,1]

# -----------------------------
# Extract metadata and filter timepoints
# -----------------------------
meta_expr <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint, expr = paste0(gene, "_expr")) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))

# -----------------------------
# Pseudobulk: average gene expression per donor per cell type
# -----------------------------
pseudobulk_df <- meta_expr %>%
  group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_expr = mean(expr), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------
# Perform t-test for each cell type
# -----------------------------
results_list <- list()
cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)

for (ct in cell_types) {
  test_res <- pseudobulk_df %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    t_test(mean_expr ~ timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  test_res$cell_type <- ct
  test_res$gene <- gene
  
  results_list[[ct]] <- test_res
}

# Combine all results
results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
results_df
```

```{r}
# a helper function to identify the root principal points:
get_earliest_principal_node <- function(cds, cell_type="Stromal1_Fetus"){
  cell_ids <- which(colData(cds)[, "cell_type"] == cell_type)
  
  closest_vertex <-
  cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  root_pr_nodes <-
  igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[as.numeric(names
  (which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids,]))))]
  
  root_pr_nodes
}
cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes=get_earliest_principal_node(cds))
```

```{r}
# Add a new column indicating group based on pseudotime
cell_data$group <- ifelse(cell_data$pseudotime >= 13.5 & cell_data$pseudotime <= 16.5,
                          "window_12_17", 
                          "other")

# Make sure it’s a factor
cell_data$group <- factor(cell_data$group, levels = c("other", "window_12_17"))

colData(cds)$group <- cell_data$group


# Fit a model for each gene
gene_fits <- fit_models(cds, model_formula_str = "~group")

# Extract results
fit_coefs <- coefficient_table(gene_fits)

# Filter for the group effect
de_results <- fit_coefs[fit_coefs$term == "groupwindow_12_17", ]

de_results$q_value <- p.adjust(de_results$p_value, method = "BH")

# Filter significant genes
significant_genes <- de_results[de_results$q_value < 0.05, ]
```

```{r}
plot_deg_go <- function(seurat_obj, go_genes, label, time1, time2, out_prefix) {
  
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$timepoint
  
  degs <- FindMarkers(
    seurat_obj,
    ident.1 = time1,
    ident.2 = time2,
    min.pct = 0.01,
    logfc.threshold = 0
  )
  
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)
  
  degs_go <- degs %>% filter(gene %in% go_genes)

  
  # Update Significance: only consider genes with abs(log2FC) > 1 AND p_val_adj < 0.05
  degs_go <- degs_go %>%
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1  ~ "Upregulated",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ))
  
  # Volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(degs_go, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = degs_go %>%
        filter(Significance != "Not Significant"),  # only label red/blue genes
      aes(label = gene),
      max.overlaps = 20,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      segment.color = 'grey50'
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title =  gsub("_", " ",paste(label, "DEGs:", time1, "vs", time2)),
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value"
    )
  
  ggsave(paste0("Figure5/Vukcano_Plot_", out_prefix, ".png"),
         plot = p, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  print(p)
  return(degs_go)
}


degs_go <- plot_deg_go(subset_amnion, interferon_gamma_genes, "REACTOME_INTERFERON_GAMMA_SIGNALING", "Week_38", "Week_25", "REACTOME_INTERFERON_GAMMA_SIGNALING")

# Filter for significant genes
sig_genes <- degs_go[degs_go$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]

# Count upregulated and downregulated
upregulated <- sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC > 0)
downregulated <- sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC < 0)

# Print results
cat("Upregulated genes:", upregulated, "\n")
cat("Downregulated genes:", downregulated, "\n")
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(openxlsx)

# Function to get gene symbols from a GO term
get_genes_from_go <- function(go_term) {
  entrez_ids <- as.character(
    unique(AnnotationDbi::select(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = go_term,
      columns = "ENTREZID",
      keytype = "GOALL"
    )$ENTREZID)
  )
  gene_symbols <- bitr(entrez_ids, fromType="ENTREZID", toType="SYMBOL", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)$SYMBOL
  return(gene_symbols)
}

# Function to plot volcano for two GO terms combined
plot_deg_go_combined <- function(seurat_obj, go_genes_list, go_labels, time1, time2, out_prefix) {
  
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$timepoint
  
  degs <- FindMarkers(
    seurat_obj,
    ident.1 = time1,
    ident.2 = time2,
    min.pct = 0.01,
    logfc.threshold = 0
  )
  
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)
  
  # Combine genes from multiple GO terms
  combined_genes <- unlist(go_genes_list)
  
  degs_go <- degs %>% filter(gene %in% combined_genes)
  
  # Assign GO category and significance
  degs_go <- degs_go %>%
    mutate(
      GO_Category = case_when(
        gene %in% go_genes_list[[1]] ~ go_labels[1],  # positive regulation
        gene %in% go_genes_list[[2]] ~ go_labels[2],  # negative regulation
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Significance = case_when(
        p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 1  ~ "Upregulated",
        p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
      ),
      Alpha = ifelse(Significance == "Not Significant", 0.3, 1)  # transparent if not significant
    )
  
  # Define colors for GO terms
  color_mapping <- setNames(c("red", "blue"), go_labels)
  
  # Volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(degs_go, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = GO_Category, alpha = Alpha)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = degs_go %>% filter(Significance != "Not Significant"),
      aes(label = gene),
      max.overlaps = 30,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      segment.color = 'grey50'
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = gsub("_", " ", paste("DEGs:", time1, "vs", time2)),
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value",
      color = "GO Term"
    ) +
    guides(alpha = "none")  # hide alpha legend
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave(paste0("Figure4/Vulcano_Plot_", out_prefix, ".png"),
         plot = p, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  print(p)
}

# --- Define GO terms ---
go_positive <- "GO:0050729"  # Positive regulation of inflammatory response
go_negative <- "GO:0050728"  # Negative regulation of inflammatory response

positive_genes <- get_genes_from_go(go_positive)
negative_genes <- get_genes_from_go(go_negative)

# --- Plot combined volcano ---
plot_deg_go_combined(
  subset_amnion,
  go_genes_list = list(positive_genes, negative_genes),
  go_labels = c("Positive Regulation", "Negative Regulation"),
  time1 = "Week_38",
  time2 = "Week_25",
  out_prefix = "Inflammatory_Response"
)
```

```{r}
# Define the immune cell receivers of interest
immune_receivers <- c("Macrophage_1_Mother", "Macrophage_2_Fetus", 
                      "NK_cell_Mother", "T_Cell_Resting_Mother")

# Get top LR pairs (all groups)
prioritized_tbl_oi_all = get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables, 
  top_n = 50, 
  receivers_oi = immune_receivers, 
  rank_per_group = TRUE
)

write_xlsx(prioritized_tbl_oi_all, "Figure5/cell_cell_comunciation_multinichnet_only_immnunsystem_receiver.xlsx")
```

```{r}
prioritized_tbl_oi = 
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% prioritized_tbl_oi_all$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>% 
  left_join(prioritized_tbl_oi_all)
prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score[is.na(prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score)] = 0

senders_receivers = union(prioritized_tbl_oi$sender %>% unique(), prioritized_tbl_oi$receiver %>% unique()) %>% sort()

# Generate enough colors for senders_receivers using Spectral as a base
colors_sender = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(senders_receivers)) %>%
  magrittr::set_names(senders_receivers)
colors_receiver = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(senders_receivers)) %>%
  magrittr::set_names(senders_receivers)

circos_list = make_circos_group_comparison(prioritized_tbl_oi, colors_sender, colors_receiver)

# Iterate over the list of plots
for (i in seq_along(circos_list)) {
  # Define a unique file name for each plot
  file_name <- paste0("Figure5/circos_plot_receiver", i, ".png")
  
  # Open the PNG device
  png(file_name, width = 800, height = 800)
  
  # Print the current circos plot in the list
  print(circos_list[[i]])
  
  # Close the PNG device
  dev.off()
  
  # Clear the circos plot environment to avoid overlapping
  circos.clear()
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
```

```{r}
# Get all interleukin genes present in the dataset
il_genes <- grep("^IL", rownames(amnion_seurat_object_filtered), value = TRUE)

expr <- FetchData(amnion_seurat_object_filtered, vars = il_genes)

# Add metadata (timepoint + cell_type)
expr$timepoint <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data$timepoint
expr$cell_type <- amnion_seurat_object_filtered@meta.data$cell_type

# Reshape into long format
expr_long <- expr %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(il_genes),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "expression"
  )

# Summarize mean expression per gene / timepoint / cell type
il_summary <- expr_long %>%
  group_by(gene, timepoint, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(mean_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot wider so each column = timepoint + cell_type
il_wide <- il_summary %>%
  unite("timepoint_celltype", timepoint, cell_type, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint_celltype,
    values_from = mean_expression
  )

# View the result
print(il_wide)

# Save as CSV
write.csv(il_wide, "Figure3/interleukin_expression_by_timepoint_celltype.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Select features for integration

# Prep for SCT integration
objs <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = objs, anchor.features = features)

# Find anchors

                                  normalization.method = "SCT", 
                                  anchor.features = features)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(DESeq2)

# --- Step 1: Convert timepoint to numeric ---
subset_amnion_epithel$timepoint_num <- as.numeric(gsub("Week_", "", subset_amnion_epithel$timepoint))

# --- Step 2: Extract counts and metadata ---
counts <- GetAssayData(subset_amnion_epithel, assay = "combined_RNA", slot = "counts")
meta <- subset_amnion_epithel@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

# --- Step 3: Combine timepoint and dataset_origin to create pseudobulk groups ---
meta$group <- paste0("W", meta$timepoint_num, "_", meta$dataset_origin)
groups <- unique(meta$group)

pseudobulk_counts <- sapply(groups, function(g) {
  cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$group == g]
  if(length(cells) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(counts))
  } else if(length(cells) == 1) {
    counts[, cells]
  } else {
    rowSums(counts[, cells, drop = FALSE])
  }
})

pseudobulk_counts <- as.matrix(pseudobulk_counts)
colnames(pseudobulk_counts) <- groups

# --- Step 4: Filter genes ---
# Keep only genes expressed (non-zero) in at least one sample for every timepoint
timepoints <- unique(meta$timepoint_num)

keep_genes <- apply(pseudobulk_counts, 1, function(x) {
  counts_per_timepoint <- sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("W", tp, "_"), colnames(pseudobulk_counts))
    sum(x[cols] > 0)  # number of non-zero samples in this timepoint
  })
  all(counts_per_timepoint > 0)  # TRUE only if all timepoints have >=1 counts
})

pseudobulk_counts_filtered <- pseudobulk_counts[keep_genes, ]

# --- Step 5: Create DESeq2 metadata ---
coldata <- data.frame(group = groups)
rownames(coldata) <- groups
coldata$timepoint_num <- as.numeric(sub("W(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", groups))
coldata$dataset_origin <- factor(sub("W\\d+_(.*)", "\\1", groups))

# --- Step 6: DESeq2 dataset ---
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pseudobulk_counts_filtered,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ dataset_origin + timepoint_num
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# Convert results to data frame
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

# Save to Excel
write.xlsx(res_df, file = "Figure6/DESeq2_timecourse_results_weekly_epithel_nobatchcorrection.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

library(tibble)

genes_of_interest <- c( "DKK1","DKK2","DKK3","SFRP1","KREMEN1","IGFBP1","IGFBP2","IGFBP3","IGFBP4","IGFBP5","IGFBP6","IGFBP7", "CDH1", "CLDN3", "CLDN4", "OCLN", "EPCAM", "KRT8", "KRT18","GRHL2","OVOL1","OVOL2","KLF4","KLF5","ESRP1","ESRP2")

genes_of_interest <- c("IGFBP3","TET1","HOXC4","CYB5R1")
# --- Subset pseudobulk counts to genes of interest ---

normalized_counts <- sweep(pseudobulk_counts, 2, colSums(pseudobulk_counts), FUN = "/")

expr_data <- normalized_counts[genes_of_interest, , drop = FALSE]

# --- Convert to long format for ggplot ---
expr_long <- expr_data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
  left_join(
    coldata %>% 
      rownames_to_column(var = "sample"), 
    by = "sample"
  )

expr_long <- expr_long %>%
  dplyr::rename(Dataset_Origin = dataset_origin) %>%
  mutate(Dataset_Origin = case_when(
    Dataset_Origin == "first_trimester" ~ "First Trimester",
    Dataset_Origin == "second_thrid_trimester" ~ "Second & Third Trimester",
    TRUE ~ Dataset_Origin  # keep any other values unchanged
  ))

# --- Plot normalized expression over time ---
p <- ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = timepoint_num, y = expression, color = Dataset_Origin)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = sample), alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~gene, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Week",
    y = "Normalized Expression",
    color = "Dataset Origin"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Axis titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),

    # Axis tick labels
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),

    # Facet strip labels
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),

    # Optional: spacing and legend position
    legend.position = "right"
  )
print(p)

ggsave("Figure6/Epithel_selected_genes_change_over_time.png",
       plot = p, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(DESeq2)
library(limma)
library(edgeR)


subset_amnion_macro_trimester$Trimester_num <- case_when(
  subset_amnion_macro_trimester$Trimester == "first"  ~ 1,
  subset_amnion_macro_trimester$Trimester == "second" ~ 2,
  subset_amnion_macro_trimester$Trimester == "third"  ~ 3
)

counts <- GetAssayData(subset_amnion_macro_trimester, assay = "combined_RNA", slot = "counts")
meta <- subset_amnion_macro_trimester@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

# Combine Trimester and dataset_origin to create unique pseudobulk groups
meta$group <- paste0("T", meta$Trimester_num, "_", meta$dataset_origin)
groups <- unique(meta$group)

pseudobulk_counts <- sapply(groups, function(g) {
  cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$group == g]
  if(length(cells) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(counts))
  } else if(length(cells) == 1) {
    counts[, cells]
  } else {
    rowSums(counts[, cells, drop = FALSE])
  }
})

pseudobulk_counts <- as.matrix(pseudobulk_counts)

# Make coldata from pseudobulk groups
coldata <- data.frame(
  group = groups
)
rownames(coldata) <- groups

# Extract trimester_num and dataset_origin from group names
coldata$Trimester_num <- as.numeric(sub("T(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", groups))
coldata$dataset_origin <- sub("T\\d+_(.*)", "\\1", groups)


# Convert dataset_origin to factor
coldata$dataset_origin <- factor(coldata$dataset_origin)

library(DESeq2)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pseudobulk_counts,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~Trimester_num  # batch + ordered trimester
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
```

#### Seurat no Donor variability
```{r}
# Create summary table of counts per cell type and condition
celltype_summary <- subset_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell_type, tissue_source) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tissue_source, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

print(celltype_summary)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Make sure identities are set to cell_type
Idents(subset_seurat) <- "cell_type"

# Count cells per cell_type & condition
cell_counts <- subset_seurat@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell_type, tissue_source) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tissue_source, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

print(cell_counts)

# Create Excel workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Loop through cell types
for (ct in unique(subset_seurat$cell_type)) {
  
  # Check if both groups have >100 cells
  ct_counts <- cell_counts %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  
  if (nrow(ct_counts) > 0 &&
      all(ct_counts$Peripher> 100, ct_counts$Placenta > 100)) {
    
    message("Running DEG for cell type: ", ct)
    
    # Subset object by cell type
    ct_obj <- subset(subset_seurat, subset = cell_type == ct)
    Idents(ct_obj) <- "tissue_source"
    
    # Run DEG
    deg <- FindMarkers(ct_obj, 
                       ident.1 = "Placenta", 
                       ident.2 = "Peripher",
                       logfc.threshold = 0,
                       min.pct = 0.1,
                       test.use = "wilcox")
    
    # Add gene column
    deg <- tibble::rownames_to_column(deg, var = "gene")
    
    # Add worksheet to Excel
    addWorksheet(wb, ct)
    writeData(wb, ct, deg)
  } else {
    message("Skipping ", ct, " (not enough cells in both groups)")
  }
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "Figure6/DEG_per_CellType_Placenta_no_Donor.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)


```


#### DEG Account for Donors Pseudobulk 

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

pseudo_bulk <- AggregateExpression(
  subset_seurat,
  assays = "RNA",
  return.seurat = TRUE,
  group.by = c("cell_type", "Donor_Nr", "tissue_source")
)


counts <- GetAssayData(pseudo_bulk, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
meta <- pseudo_bulk@meta.data

meta <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, Donor_Nr, tissue_source)

meta$cell_type <- factor(meta$cell_type)
meta$Donor_Nr <- factor(meta$Donor_Nr)
meta$tissue_source <- factor(meta$tissue_source)
meta$tissue_source <- relevel(meta$tissue_source, ref = "Peripher")

cell_types <- levels(meta$cell_type)

# Create Excel workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

de_list <- list()

for (ct in cell_types) {

  message("Processing cell type: ", ct)

  # Subset to one cell type
  samples_ct <- meta$cell_type == ct

  counts_ct <- counts[, samples_ct]
  meta_ct <- meta[samples_ct, ]

  meta_ct_df <- as.data.frame(meta_ct)

donors_keep <- meta_ct_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Donor_Nr, tissue_source) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tissue_source,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Placenta > 0 & Peripher > 0) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Donor_Nr)

  keep <- meta_ct$Donor_Nr %in% donors_keep
  counts_ct <- counts_ct[, keep]
  meta_ct <- meta_ct[keep, ]

  # Skip if not enough donors
  if (length(unique(meta_ct$Donor_Nr)) < 2) {
    message("  Skipping ", ct, " (not enough paired donors)")
    next
  }

  # DESeq2 object (paired design)
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts_ct,
    colData = meta_ct,
    design = ~ Donor_Nr + tissue_source
  )

  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)

  res <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c("tissue_source", "Placenta", "Peripher")
  )

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$Gene <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df <- res_df[order(res_df$padj), ]

  # Optional filtering
  res_df <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj), ]
  
  # Store DE results with cell type annotation
  de_list[[ct]] <- res_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = ct)


  # Add worksheet
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = ct)

  writeData(
    wb,
    sheet = ct,
    x = res_df
  )
}


output_file <- "Figure6/DE_pseudobulk_by_celltype.xlsx"
saveWorkbook(wb, file = output_file, overwrite = TRUE)

```
