```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

colnames(df_all)[1] <- "category"

df_plot <- df_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% c("Reactome", "GO Component")) %>%
  # Optionally remove terms with missing values
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`term description`) & !is.na(cell_type))

df_plot$cell_type <- factor(df_plot$cell_type, levels = unique(df_plot$cell_type))

# Optional: reorder terms by overall enrichment score (sum across cell types)
term_order <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(`term description`) %>%
  summarise(mean_enrichment = mean(`enrichment score`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_enrichment)) %>%
  pull(`term description`)

df_plot$`term description` <- factor(df_plot$`term description`, levels = term_order)

p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(
        x = `term description`,
        y = cell_type,
        size = `enrichment score`,
        color = `false discovery rate`

  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue", trans = "log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()

  labs(
    color = "FDR",

    title = "Enrichment Dotplot for Reactome & GO Component Terms"

  facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)  # separate x-axis for Reactome and GO Component

ggsave("Figure6/GO_Reactome_dotplot.png",
       plot = p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

outdir <- "Figure6/MDS_plots"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


plot_mds_celltype <- function(seurat_obj, celltype, outdir) {

  message("Processing cell type: ", celltype)

  # Subset cell type
  obj_ct <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type == celltype)

  # Skip if too few cells
  if (ncol(obj_ct) < 50) {
    message("Skipping ", celltype, ": too few cells")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Counts and metadata
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj_ct, slot = "counts")
  meta <- obj_ct@meta.data[colnames(counts), ]

  # Donor pseudobulk
  donor <- factor(meta$Donor_Nr)
  donor_mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + donor)
  colnames(donor_mm) <- levels(donor)

  pb_counts <- counts %*% donor_mm

  # Donor-level metadata
  donor_meta <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Donor_Nr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, Condition, timepoint)

  rownames(donor_meta) <- donor_meta$Donor_Nr
  donor_meta$Donor_Nr <- NULL
  donor_meta <- donor_meta[colnames(pb_counts), , drop = FALSE]

  # Factors
  donor_meta$Condition <- factor(donor_meta$Condition)
  donor_meta$timepoint <- factor(donor_meta$timepoint)

  # Safety checks
  if (length(unique(donor_meta$Condition)) < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", celltype, ": only one condition present")
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (nrow(donor_meta) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", celltype, ": too few donors")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Design matrix
  design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + Condition, data = donor_meta)

  # voom normalization
  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb_counts)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)

  # MDS
  mds <- plotMDS(v, plot = FALSE)

  mds_df <- data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$x,
    Dim2 = mds$y,
    donor_meta
  )

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    mds_df,
    aes(
      x = Dim1,
      y = Dim2,
      color = Condition,
      shape = timepoint
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    labs(
      title = paste("MDS –", celltype),
      x = "MDS dimension 1",
      y = "MDS dimension 2"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  # Safe filename
  fname <- paste0(
    outdir, "/MDS_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", celltype),
    ".png"
  )

  # Save plot
  ggsave(
    filename = fname,
    plot = p,
    width = 6,
    height = 5
  )
  print(p)

  invisible(NULL)
}

celltypes <- sort(unique(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type))

for (ct in celltypes) {
  plot_mds_celltype(
    seurat_obj = amnion_seurat_object,
    celltype = ct,
    outdir = outdir
  )
}

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

amnion_seurat_object$Condition <- ifelse(
  amnion_seurat_object$Donor_Nr %in% c(26, 41),
  "Preeclampsia",
  "Healthy"
)

run_pseudobulk_limma <- function(seurat_obj, celltype, min_cells_per_donor = 30) {
  
  obj_ct <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type == celltype)
  
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj_ct, slot = "counts")
  meta <- obj_ct@meta.data[colnames(counts), ]
  
  stopifnot(ncol(counts) == nrow(meta))
  
  # Count cells per donor
  cells_per_donor <- table(meta$Donor_Nr)
  
  # Filter out donors with too few cells
  donors_to_keep <- names(cells_per_donor[cells_per_donor >= min_cells_per_donor])
  
  if (length(donors_to_keep) < 3) {
    warning(paste0("Cell type ", celltype, " has fewer than 3 donors with >=", 
                   min_cells_per_donor, " cells. Skipping."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Filter metadata and counts to keep only donors with enough cells
  meta <- meta[meta$Donor_Nr %in% donors_to_keep, ]
  counts <- counts[, rownames(meta)]
  
  cat(sprintf("  %s: Keeping %d/%d donors with >=%d cells\n", 
              celltype, length(donors_to_keep), length(cells_per_donor), min_cells_per_donor))
  
  donor <- factor(meta$Donor_Nr)
  donor_mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + donor)
  colnames(donor_mm) <- levels(donor)
  
  pb_counts <- counts %*% donor_mm
  
  donor_meta <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Donor_Nr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, Condition, timepoint) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  rownames(donor_meta) <- donor_meta$Donor_Nr
  donor_meta$Donor_Nr <- NULL
  
  donor_meta <- donor_meta[colnames(pb_counts), , drop = FALSE]
  
  donor_meta$Condition <- factor(donor_meta$Condition)
  print(levels(donor_meta$Condition))
  
  donor_meta$timepoint <- as.numeric(
    gsub("[^0-9.]", "", donor_meta$timepoint)
  )
  
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(donor_meta$timepoint)))
  stopifnot(length(unique(donor_meta$Condition)) == 2)
  stopifnot(nrow(donor_meta) >= 3)
  
  design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + Condition, data = donor_meta)
  
  stopifnot(nrow(design) == ncol(pb_counts))
  
  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb_counts)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  
  v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
  fit <- lmFit(v, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  coef_name <- grep("^Condition", colnames(design), value = TRUE)
  
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  res$gene <- rownames(res)
  res$cell_type <- celltype
  
  return(res)
}

# Run analysis for all cell types
celltypes <- unique(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type)
results_list <- list()

for (ct in celltypes) {
  message("Running cell type: ", ct)
  
  res <- run_pseudobulk_limma(
    seurat_obj = amnion_seurat_object,
    celltype = ct,
    min_cells_per_donor = 30  # Require at least 30 cells per donor
  )
  
  # Only add to results if not NULL (i.e., enough donors passed filter)
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    results_list[[ct]] <- res
  }
}

# Save to Excel
wb <- createWorkbook()
for (ct in names(results_list)) {
  addWorksheet(wb, ct)
  writeData(wb, ct, results_list[[ct]])
}
saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  file = "Figure6/PE_vs_Normal_pseudobulk_limma_by_celltype.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CREATE VOLCANO PLOT PANEL PER CELL TYPE
# ============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

# Define thresholds
padj_threshold <- 0.05
logfc_threshold <- 1

# Combine all cell types into one dataframe
volcano_data <- map_dfr(names(results_list), function(ct) {
  df <- results_list[[ct]]
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      cell_type = ct,
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(adj.P.Val),
      significant = adj.P.Val < padj_threshold & abs(logFC) > logfc_threshold
    )
})

# Count significant genes per cell type
sig_counts <- volcano_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(significant) %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_type, name = "n_sig")

# Add counts back for facet titles
volcano_data <- volcano_data %>%
  left_join(sig_counts, by = "cell_type") %>%
  mutate(
    n_sig = ifelse(is.na(n_sig), 0, n_sig),
    facet_label = paste0(cell_type, "\n(n = ", n_sig, " significant genes)")
  )

# Volcano plot panel
p_volcano <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log10_padj)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = significant),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1
  ) +
  
  # Threshold lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logfc_threshold, logfc_threshold),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_threshold),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  
  facet_wrap(~ facet_label, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = "firebrick")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plots of Differential Expression by Cell Type",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Thresholds: |log2FC| > ", logfc_threshold,
      ", adjusted p-value < ", padj_threshold
    ),
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (Preeclampsia vs Healthy)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray40")
  )

# Save plots
ggsave(
  "Figure6/volcano_panel_by_celltype.pdf",
  plot = p_volcano,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "Figure6/volcano_panel_by_celltype.png",
  plot = p_volcano,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

# Print plot
print(p_volcano)

library(Seurat)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

outdir <- "Figure6/MDS_plots"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

compute_mds_celltype <- function(seurat_obj, celltype) {

  obj_ct <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = cell_type == celltype)

  if (ncol(obj_ct) < 50) return(NULL)

  counts <- GetAssayData(obj_ct, slot = "counts")
  meta <- obj_ct@meta.data[colnames(counts), ]

  donor <- factor(meta$Donor_Nr)
  donor_mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + donor)
  colnames(donor_mm) <- levels(donor)

  pb_counts <- counts %*% donor_mm

  donor_meta <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Donor_Nr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, Condition, timepoint)

  rownames(donor_meta) <- donor_meta$Donor_Nr
  donor_meta$Donor_Nr <- NULL
  donor_meta <- donor_meta[colnames(pb_counts), , drop = FALSE]

  donor_meta$Condition <- factor(donor_meta$Condition)
  donor_meta$timepoint <- factor(donor_meta$timepoint)

  if (length(unique(donor_meta$Condition)) < 2) return(NULL)
  if (nrow(donor_meta) < 3) return(NULL)

  design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + Condition, data = donor_meta)

  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb_counts)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)

  mds <- plotMDS(v, plot = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    Dim1 = mds$x,
    Dim2 = mds$y,
    Condition = donor_meta$Condition,
    timepoint = donor_meta$timepoint,
    cell_type = celltype
  )
}

subset_cells$grouping <- factor(subset_cells$grouping, levels = group_levels)

# Dot plot
p <- DotPlot(subset_cells,
        features = genes_of_interest,
        group.by = "grouping") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Selection of Interferon Gamma related Genes",
    x = "Genes",
    y = "Cell Type - Tissue Source"
  )


ggsave("Figure6/Preeclampsia_Interferon_Gamma_upregulated.png",
      plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Create summary table of counts per cell type and condition
celltype_summary <- subset_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

print(celltype_summary)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Make sure identities are set to cell_type
Idents(subset_obj) <- "cell_type"

# Count cells per cell_type & condition
cell_counts <- subset_obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(cell_type, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0)

print(cell_counts)

# Create Excel workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Loop through cell types
for (ct in unique(subset_obj$cell_type)) {
  
  # Check if both groups have >100 cells
  ct_counts <- cell_counts %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  
  if (nrow(ct_counts) > 0 &&
      all(ct_counts$Week_34 > 100, ct_counts$Week_38 > 100)) {
    
    message("Running DEG for cell type: ", ct)
    
    # Subset object by cell type
    ct_obj <- subset(subset_obj, subset = cell_type == ct)
    Idents(ct_obj) <- "timepoint"
    
    # Run DEG
    deg <- FindMarkers(ct_obj, 
                       ident.1 = "Week_34", 
                       ident.2 = "Week_38",
                       logfc.threshold = 0,
                       min.pct = 0.1,
                       test.use = "wilcox")
    
    # Add gene column
    deg <- tibble::rownames_to_column(deg, var = "gene")
    
    # Add worksheet to Excel
    addWorksheet(wb, ct)
    writeData(wb, ct, deg)
  } else {
    message("Skipping ", ct, " (not enough cells in both groups)")
  }
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "Figure6/DEG_per_CellType_Preeclampsia_Week_34_Week_38.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

### Stress Genes

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(msigdbr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_Stress"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Setup: Define the Stress GO terms
all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
stress_terms <- c(
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS", 
  "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS", 
  "GOBP_ACUTE_PHASE_RESPONSE"
)

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

all_stress_stats <- list()

message("Starting global stress analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Loop through terms
for (term in stress_terms) {
  
  term_genes_raw <- all_human_genesets %>%
    filter(gs_name == term) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
  
  valid_genes <- intersect(term_genes_raw, rownames(seurat_subset))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", term, ": Insufficient gene coverage.")
    next
  }
  
  # Add module score
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(seurat_subset, features = list(valid_genes), name = "Stress_Mod_")
  
  # Fetch data
  plot_data <- FetchData(seurat_subset, vars = c("Stress_Mod_1", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr"))
  colnames(plot_data) <- c("Score", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  
  # A. Plotting
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Score, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Global Stress:", str_replace_all(term, "_", " ")),
      subtitle = paste("Based on", length(valid_genes), "detected genes"),
      y = "Aggregate Stress Score", 
      x = "Gestational Age"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Save Plot
  safe_name <- str_remove(term, "GOBP_")
  ggsave(file.path(si_dir, paste0(safe_name, "_plot.png")), plot = p, width = 6, height = 5)
  
  # B. Statistics (Pseudobulk)
  stats <- plot_data %>% 
    group_by(Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint)
  
  stats$term <- term
  all_stress_stats[[term]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Stress_Mod_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Summary Export
if (length(all_stress_stats) > 0) {
  results_df <- bind_rows(all_stress_stats) %>% adjust_pvalue(method = "BH")
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "Stress_Pathway_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Success! Analysis complete. Files saved in: ", si_dir)
}
```

#### GO term for telomer maintenanca

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(msigdbr)
library(rstatix)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_Telomeres"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Subset
seurat_subset <- subset(
  amnion_seurat_object, 
  subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38")
)

all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
telomere_pathways <- all_human_genesets %>%
  filter(grepl("TELOMERE_MAINTENANCE", gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE))

pathway_names <- unique(telomere_pathways$gs_name)
all_pathway_stats <- list()

message("Starting Telomere analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Execution Loop
for (pathway in pathway_names) {
  
  pathway_genes <- telomere_pathways %>%
    filter(gs_name == pathway) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
  
  valid_pathway_genes <- intersect(pathway_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
  
  if (length(valid_pathway_genes) == 0) next
  
  # Calculate Module Score
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    features = list(valid_pathway_genes), 
    name = "Temp_Module_"
  )
  
  # Fetch data
  plot_data <- FetchData(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    vars = c("Temp_Module_1", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr")
  )
  colnames(plot_data) <- c("Expression", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  
  # Plot
  clean_title <- str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " ")
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cell_type, y = Expression, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = "Telomere Maintenance Pathway",
      subtitle = str_wrap(clean_title, width = 70),
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Aggregate Module Score"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save Plot
  file_name <- paste0(str_remove(pathway, "GOBP_"), ".png")
  ggsave(file.path(si_dir, file_name), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  # Stats (Pseudobulk)
  stats <- plot_data %>% 
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>% 
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  stats$module <- pathway
  all_pathway_stats[[pathway]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Assembly & Export
results_df <- bind_rows(all_pathway_stats) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "Telomere_Pathway_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

message("Success! Telomere analysis complete. Results in: ", si_dir)
```




#### DAMPs

```{r}
"from: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2020.00602/full#T1"
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_DAMPs"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Define Genes
damp_genes <- c(
  "ACAN", "BGN", "DCN", "FN1", "FGA", "FGB", "FGG", "TNC", "VCAN", # ECM DAMPs
  "PPIA", "ACTB", "HSPA1A", "HSPA1B", "HSPA2", "HSP90AA1", "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12", "APP", # Chaperones
  "HMGB1", "IL1A", "IL33", "SF3B3", "H3-3A" # Nuclear Alarmins
)

# Subset
seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

# Verify genes
valid_genes <- intersect(damp_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
all_gene_stats <- list()

message("Starting DAMPs analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Execution Loop
for (gene in valid_genes) {
  
  # A. Visualization
  plot_data <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c(gene, "Cell Type", "Gestational Age"))
  colnames(plot_data)[1] <- "Expression"
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = Expression, fill = `Gestational Age`)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("DAMP / Alarmin Profile:", gene),
      subtitle = "Gestational Divergence: Mid-Gestation vs. Term",
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Log-Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(si_dir, paste0(gene, "_DAMP.png")), 
    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
  
  # B. Statistics (Pseudobulk)
  meta_scores <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c("Donor_Nr", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", gene))
  colnames(meta_scores) <- c("Donor_Nr", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Expression")
  
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    ct_data <- pseudobulk_df %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
    if(length(unique(ct_data$Timepoint)) == 2 && nrow(ct_data) >= 3) {
      test_res <- ct_data %>% t_test(mean_expr ~ Timepoint) %>% add_significance("p")
      test_res$cell_type <- ct
      test_res$gene <- gene 
      all_gene_stats[[paste0(gene, "_", ct)]] <- test_res
    }
  }
}

# 4. Final Assembly
results_df <- bind_rows(all_gene_stats)

if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
  results_df <- results_df %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    arrange(p.adj)
  
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "DAMP_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Analysis Complete. Results and figures saved in ", si_dir)
}
```

    ) +

    group_by(cell_type) %>% 
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  stats$module <- pathway
  all_pathway_stats[[pathway]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Assembly & Export
results_df <- bind_rows(all_pathway_stats) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

### Cell Type Enrichment


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Setup & Directory Creation
main_dir <- "SI_Figure_Enrichment"
if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) dir.create(main_dir)

# Pre-load Databases
hallmark_db <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>% 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
reactome_db <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME") %>% 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

# 2. Define Enrichment Function
# This function handles the logic for different databases and saves the plots
save_enrichment_plot <- function(gene_list, db_type, cell_type, direction, base_path) {
  if (length(gene_list) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  enrich_res <- NULL
  title <- paste(db_type, direction, "in", cell_type)
  
  # Logic based on database type
  if (db_type == "GO_BP") {
    enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = gene_list, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  } else if (db_type == "KEGG") {
    ids <- bitr(gene_list, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")
    enrich_res <- enrichKEGG(gene = ids$ENTREZID, organism = 'hsa', pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  } else if (db_type %in% c("Hallmark", "Reactome")) {
    term2gene <- if(db_type == "Hallmark") hallmark_db else reactome_db
    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = gene_list, TERM2GENE = term2gene, pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  }
  
  # Save Plot
  if (!is.null(enrich_res) && nrow(enrich_res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)) > 0) {
    p <- dotplot(enrich_res, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle(title)
    file_name <- file.path(base_path, paste0(db_type, "_", direction, ".png"))
    ggsave(file_name, p, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}

# 3. Main Loop
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "Cell Type"
cell_types <- unique(Idents(amnion_seurat_object))

for (ct in cell_types) {
  message("Processing Cell Type: ", ct)
  
  # Create directory for this cell type
  ct_dir <- file.path(main_dir, gsub(" ", "_", ct))
  if (!dir.exists(ct_dir)) dir.create(ct_dir)
  
  # A. Differential Expression
  de_markers <- FindMarkers(
    object = amnion_seurat_object, 
    subset.ident = ct, 
    group.by = "Gestational Age", 
    ident.1 = "Week 38", 
    ident.2 = "Week 25"
  )
  
  up_genes <- rownames(de_markers[de_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de_markers$avg_log2FC > 0, ])
  down_genes <- rownames(de_markers[de_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de_markers$avg_log2FC < 0, ])
  
  # B. Run all Enrichments
  dbs <- c("GO_BP", "KEGG", "Hallmark", "Reactome")
  
  for (db in dbs) {
    save_enrichment_plot(up_genes, db, ct, "Up Week 38", ct_dir)
    save_enrichment_plot(down_genes, db, ct, "Up Week 25", ct_dir)
  }
}

```

    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = gene_list, TERM2GENE = term2gene, pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  }
  
  # Save Plot
  if (!is.null(enrich_res) && nrow(enrich_res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)) > 0) {

}

# 3. Main Loop

```{r}
top10 <- markers %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)  # top 10 positive markers by logFC

# 2. Get expression matrix for top genes

# 3. Order cells by cell type

```{r}
filtered_seurat_object <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = Donor_Nr %in% male_fetus)
metadata <- filtered_seurat_object@meta.data
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Assuming metadata is already defined
# Ensure `cell_type` and `scType_Pique` are characters
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(cell_type = as.character(cell_type), 
         scType_Pique = as.character(scType_Pique))

# Calculate the ratio of male and female cells for each cluster
ratio_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(prediction)) %>%
  group_by(RNA_snn_res.1, prediction) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prediction, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = Male + Female,
         Male_ratio = Male / total)

# Get cluster information for titles
cluster_info <- metadata %>%
  group_by(RNA_snn_res.1) %>%
  summarise(cell_type = unique(cell_type)[1],  # Get the first unique cell_type
            scType_Pique = unique(scType_Pique)[1],  # Get the first unique scType_Pique
            .groups = 'drop')

# Join the ratio data with cluster info
ratio_df <- ratio_df %>%
  left_join(cluster_info, by = "RNA_snn_res.1")

# Convert RNA_snn_res.1 to factor to maintain order
ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1 <- factor(ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1, levels = unique(ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1))

# Plot 1: Total Number of Cells by Cell Type
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = total, fill = "Total Cells")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Total Cells", 
       title = "Total Number of Cells by Cluster (Cell Type)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$cell_type)

# Plot 2: Male Ratio by Cell Type
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = Male_ratio, fill = "Male Ratio")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Male Ratio", 
       title = "Male Ratio by Cluster (Cell Type)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$cell_type)

# Plot 3: Total Number of Cells by scType_Pique
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = total, fill = "Total Cells")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Total Cells", 
       title = "Total Number of Cells by Cluster (scType_Pique)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$scType_Pique)

# Plot 4: Male Ratio by scType_Pique

  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +

  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Male Ratio", title = "Male Ratio by Cell Type") +

  "KRT7", "EPCAM",               # Epithelial

  "CD34", "PTPRC",               # HSC 
  
  # Immune

  "NKG7", "GNLY", "NCAM1",       # NK Cells
  "CD3D", "CD3E"                 # T-Cells
)

# 3. Filter genes present in your specific matrix
genes_to_plot <- intersect(unique(literature_markers), rownames(amnion_seurat_object))

# 4. Set active identity to your cell type column
# Ensure "cell_type" matches the exact name of your metadata column containing the 14 cell types
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "cell_type" 

# 5. Generate the DotPlot

# 6. Save directly into the new directory

ggsave(filename = output_filepath, plot = p_marker_proof, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

print(paste("Plot successfully saved to:", output_filepath))

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Ensure directory exists
output_dir <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) { dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE) }

# 2. Set active identity to your cell types
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "cell_type" # Adjust to your metadata column name

# 3. Find unbiased markers for ALL cell types (this might take a couple of minutes)
print("Calculating cell type markers...")
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  amnion_seurat_object, 
  only.pos = TRUE,          # Only look for genes up-regulated in that cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,           # Gene must be in at least 25% of the cells
  logfc.threshold = 0.25    # Minimum log-fold change
)

```

```{r}
# 4. Filter out the top 10 markers per cell type based on fold-change
top10_markers <- all_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 15) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5. CRITICAL STEP: DoHeatmap requires genes to be in the "scale.data" slot
# We run ScaleData quickly on just these specific top markers
amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = unique(top10_markers$gene))

# 6. Generate the Heatmap
# We downsample the cells temporarily just for the plot so it renders fast and looks clean
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  subset(amnion_seurat_object, downsample = 200), # Plots up to 100 cells per cluster max
  features = top10_markers$gene, 
  group.by = "cell_type",
  size = 4,          # Size of cell type labels at the top
  angle = 45         # Angle of labels
) + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("purple", "black", "yellow")) + # Classic Seurat heatmap colors
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5, face = "italic"))    # Shrink gene text to fit 140 genes

# 7. Save the figure
output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Supplementary_Top10_Markers_Heatmap.png")
ggsave(filename = output_path, plot = p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 16, dpi = 300)

print(paste("Heatmap saved to:", output_path))

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure output directory exists
output_dir <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) { dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE) }

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CRITICAL FIX 1: Lock in the exact order of your cell types
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert cell_type to a factor if it isn't already, and extract the clean order
amnion_seurat_object$cell_type <- factor(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type)
desired_cluster_order <- levels(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type)

# Force the Seurat object identities to use this exact factor ordering
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "cell_type"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CRITICAL FIX 2: Direct sorting (Seurat handles the Y-axis flip automatically!)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
top15_markers <- all_markers %>%
  # Force the 'cluster' column to match your exact cell type factor levels
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = desired_cluster_order)) %>%
  # Drop any NA clusters if they exist, then arrange strictly by this order
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  # Now grab the top 15 markers per cell type
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Extract the genes while preserving this exact sorted cluster order
ordered_genes <- unique(top15_markers$gene)

# FIX: We use ordered_genes directly here. No rev() needed!
genes_for_heatmap <- ordered_genes

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Scale Data layer (Only on the selected features to save memory/time)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = genes_for_heatmap)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Generate the Diagonal Heatmap (Top-Left to Bottom-Right)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  subset(amnion_seurat_object, downsample = 200), 
  features = genes_for_heatmap, 
  group.by = "cell_type",
  size = 4,          
  angle = 45         
) + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("purple", "black", "yellow")) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4, face = "italic"), 
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# 7. Save the figure
output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Supplementary_Top15_Markers_Heatmap.png")
ggsave(filename = output_path, plot = p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 18, dpi = 300)

print(paste("Perfect top-left to bottom-right heatmap saved to:", output_path))
```

#Package Versions
```{r}
# List of packages
packages <- c(
  "openxlsx", "Seurat", "ggplot2", "cowplot", "dplyr", "limma", "clustree",
  "viridis", "glue", "knitr", "BiocParallel", "here", "writexl", "jsonlite",
  "tidyverse", "ggrepel", "stringr", "speckle", "RColorBrewer", "rstatix",
  "SingleCellExperiment", "nichenetr", "multinichenetr", "circlize",
  "clusterProfiler", "org.Hs.eg.db", "monocle3", "SeuratWrappers",
  "msigdbr", "Matrix", "DESeq2", "tibble", "purrr", "pheatmap", "cellXY"
)

# Remove duplicates
packages <- unique(packages)

# Get versions and create formatted strings
pkg_versions <- sapply(packages, function(pkg) {
  if(requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    sprintf("%s (v%s)", pkg, as.character(packageVersion(pkg)))
  } else {
    sprintf("%s (not installed)", pkg)
  }
})

# Print all on a single line, separated by commas
cat(paste(pkg_versions, collapse = ", "))


```
